facts.fact: The DGSN's 2024 annual review says its technical teams added to GESTARR, the computerised management system of the police arrondissements, a system for managing crime and misdemeanour cases at those proximity units, with the procedures drawn up digitised, following each case from the GESTARR data through investigation to submission to the judicial authorities.

The DGSN's 2024 review says the case-management system is in use in 12 commands (the police prefectures of Kénitra, Tangier, Settat, Marrakech and Meknès, the regional sûretés of Ouarzazate, Errachidia, Taza and Al Hoceima, and the provincial sûretés of Salé, Safi and El Jadida), with national generalisation in view; it gives no count of arrondissements and no total.
The DGSN's 2024 review says that during 2024 the crime and misdemeanour case-management system was integrated into GESTARR and put to use in 12 named commands, ahead of national generalisation.
The DGSN's 2024 review says its own technical teams modernised GESTARR and built the case-management system added to it.
